svg.title: From connection to a verified WEIKAV keyboard configuration
svg.desc: Connect with USB-C or the 2.4 GHz receiver. Edit and preview a profile locally. Apply writes the settings to the WEIKAV keyboard and reads them back for verification. Bluetooth configuration is unavailable.

g.text: Edit and preview on your computer
Save to the keyboard, then check
Choose either connection. Bluetooth configuration is not available.
